title: Record and diagnose browser access failures and broken web fallback tools
description:
Observed 2026-09-08 20:34-20:38 UTC during an operator-requested Omarchy impact assessment. The linked Reddit post could not be read; its contents and impact remain unverified.

1. Reddit public share URL https://www.reddit.com/r/omarchy/s/TFRyGx80h6: UIAI browser displayed 'blocked by network security'; old.reddit.com variant also displayed Blocked. Independent KH HTTP HEAD returned HTTP/2 403 with retry-after: 0. No login attempted. Cause not established; network reputation is a hypothesis, not proof.
2. Google exact-link search through UIAI: redirected to an unusual-traffic/CAPTCHA page. No CAPTCHA solution or authenticated session attempted. HTTP status not captured.
3. Public reader fallback r.jina.ai: challenge page said verification successful but remained waiting on two reads about 27 seconds apart. Classify as stalled challenge/navigation, not a confirmed final HTTP denial. No further challenge interaction attempted.
4. web_search and fetch_content: each returned 'signal is not defined'. Source diagnosis: /root/.pi/agent/extensions/pi-web-access/index.ts declares execute(..., _signal, ...) at lines 174 and 397, but references undeclared signal at lines 199 and 411. This defect accounts for both observed errors and is separate from site blocking. No patch, activation or successful recovery is claimed.

Detailed browser diagnostics were collected in the existing restricted tool evidence store. Public/task records must exclude cookies, authorization values, challenge query strings, browser-control/share tokens, private browsing history and user data. No successful recovery has been demonstrated.

Next: locate existing browser diagnostic/incident and web-tool owners; correlate runtime/version, timestamps, sanitized origin/path, navigation stage, status/redirect, challenge classification, browser mode, authenticated-state boolean, approved network route, attempt count and recovery outcome. Unknown fields remain unknown. Reuse existing diagnostics and evidence storage; do not introduce another authority/store. Deduplicate by origin/failure signature with attempt counts. Separate network, browser/session, provider/API and local-tool causes.

Acceptance: sanitized records are retained for all four observed failures; the web-tool error has an identified owner and regression/recovery evidence; supported browser/API/private-session access is tested with bounded retries; successful reads are demonstrated on the actual requested source or remaining restrictions are explicit. No credential exposure, mass retries, identity spoofing, public-profile login or deployment changes as part of diagnosis. Preserve the separately approved desktop/Focusa-extension work.
